summary: Phase 5 of 8 complete (both sub-phases). Sub-phase 5.1 collapsed all 24 `XAxiom_implies_YAxiom` subsumption lemmas in `Cslib/Logics/Modal/Metalogic/InterSystem/AxiomSubsumption.lean` from hand-written `match`-on-constructor proofs to the generic form `bridgeY.mp (SchemaUnion.subsumption (by decide) (bridgeX.mpr h))`, routing through the Phase-1 `SchemaUnion.subsumption` lemma (`Cslib/Logics/Modal/ProofSystem/SchemaUnion.lean`) and the Phase-3 bridge equivalences (`Cslib/Logics/Modal/ProofSystem/SchemaBridges.lean`). Every public lemma name preserved verbatim; each `xTags subseteq yTags` obligation discharges by `decide` against the concrete `Finset`s, with implicit tag-set unification working out via expected-type propagation (no explicit type ascriptions needed). The deliberately-omitted `KB5 -> S5` edge stays absent and is now mechanically explained: `kb5Tags` carries `modalFive`, which is not a member of `s5Tags` (S5 = T+4+B, carries `modalB` not `modalFive`), so no `hsub : kb5Tags subseteq s5Tags` term exists -- grep-confirmed no such lemma was introduced. Sub-phase 5.2 investigated `Lifting.lean`/`Modularity.lean` line-by-line (excluding doc comments) for actual code call sites referencing any of the 24 lemma names, and found none: `Lifting.lean` is fully parametric (`Derivable_mono`/`liftDerivation` take free `Axioms1 Axioms2 : Proposition Atom -> Prop` and `h_sub : forall phi, Axioms1 phi -> Axioms2 phi` hypotheses; the one mention of `KAxiom_implies_TAxiom` at line 37 is a usage example in the module doc comment, which remains accurate verbatim since the name/signature is preserved). `Modularity.lean` references the axiom *predicates* directly (`KAxiom`, `TAxiom`, `S4Axiom`, `ModalAxiom`, plus out-of-scope minimal/intuitionistic families) but never applies any of the 24 subsumption lemma names as terms. Both files already built green against the 5.1 changes with zero edits required -- confirming the plan's 'insulated... no structural change' framing was correct, and in this instance the 'few call sites' resolved to zero actual call sites needing a name update. Zero sorry, zero new axiom, zero vacuous definitions across all touched files. Net line delta in AxiomSubsumption.lean vs. the pre-Phase-5 baseline: 73 insertions, 368 deletions = -295 lines net (git diff --stat across the two phase-5 commits). Stopping here per single-phase dispatch scope; Phases 6-8 not started.
